messages:
anya: Heads-up — final preflight for v0.23.0. Cutoff in ~18h. Need sign-offs on security checklist, docs spot-check, and the version bump. Who can own changelog + version bump?

sam: I can take the changelog + release notes. Will open a PR in the next hour.

kevin: QA here — I'll run the full regression on staging tonight. Can someone paste the smoke test list?

anya: quick list: auth/login, streaming generation, embeddings endpoint, batch inference, and long-context KV cache sanity. Also @liz for security review.

liz: picking this up now. Doing dependency scan + SCA checks. Will report blockers by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder: branch-cut window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Please avoid merging unrelated changes during that slot.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3124 — bumps package.json + changelog entries. Includes entry for performance regression fix.

sam: version bump snippet in PR:
```json
{"name":"redwood-platform","version":"0.23.0"}
```

kevin: QA run started (staging-2026-03-18). Early smoke failed on image-gen FF1 intermittently — re-running with debug logs. I filed a tiny test-only skip for that case so cutoff isn't blocked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLT-4567

qa-bot: Regression suite: 46/47 tests passed. Failing test: image-gen/overflow (intermittent).

liz: Security update: SCA flagged transitive dependency "x-dep" at v1.4.7 (low severity). Recommend pin to 1.4.8 in the package lock. No credential exposure, no P1s. I'll attach remediation PR by EOD.

anya: thanks — can you add the SCA note to the release notes under "known issues"? small mention so docs teams know.

sam: will do. Adding a short bullet in changelog and release notes.

kevin: QA final pass: staging tests green except image-gen flakiness flagged as flaky, not blocking release. We'll monitor post-cut.

liz: Security sign-off: ✅ pending the lockfile pin (PR forthcoming). No blocker.

anya: Owners roll-call: changelog & version bump = @sam; QA = @kevin; security = @liz; docs spot-check = @sam (can you ping docs for a quick pass?)

sam: ping @docs-team — quick perf wording check needed in "Release notes" and "Upgrade guide".

docs-team: (in thread) We'll take a 30m pass tomorrow morning, should be fine.

anya: OK — unless anything else, plan to cut at 09:05 UTC tomorrow, within the branch-cut window. If you need me to delay, speak now or file a blocker. :shipit: 

sam: noted, I'll merge after your go-ahead and then tag.

kevin: monitoring hooks and post-deploy smoke in place. I'll report any regressions in #incidents.

anya: final: thanks all. Small PRs to expect: changelog + bump (sam), lockfile pin (liz), docs pass (docs-team). Will post final cutoff thread 30m before.

ops-bot: Scheduled notification: Release cut at 2026-03-19 09:05 UTC (window 09:00-11:00)"
